title: Which Wish Did the AI Write?

texts.a: Happy 80th, Ammamma! Still remember you running behind my cycle, holding the seat. Keep the pulihora ready, coming at 7! - Teja
texts.b: Happy 80th birthday, Grandma! May this special day be filled with love, joy, and all the happiness you deserve. Here's to another wonderful chapter in your life! 🎉🎂💖
texts.made: Your pulihora is still the best in the family, and I miss you dearly.

lines.text: Ammamma turns eighty. [1] Teja typed his wish for ten minutes. Sai tapped an AI once.
lines.show: Ammamma turns 80. Teja typed his wish for 10 minutes. Sai tapped an AI once.

lines.text: Which one did the AI write? [1] One, or two?
lines.show: Which one did the AI write? One, or two?

lines.text: Two. [1] It could go to any grandmother on earth.
lines.show: Two. It could go to any grandmother on earth.

lines.text: One has her running behind his cycle, and her pulihora. [1] Only her family knows those.
lines.show: One has her running behind his cycle, and her pulihora. Only her family knows those.

lines.text: We asked a small free AI the same thing, ten times. [1] Ten out of ten: "May this special day". Not one thing only she'd know.
lines.show: We asked a small free AI the same thing, 10 times. 10 out of 10: "May this special day". Not one thing only she'd know.

lines.text: Then we gave it the two real details. [1] It used both, every time. But six times it added "I miss you"... and Sai lives next door.

yt.chapter: Let it write, the right way
yt.title: Let it write, the right way

lines.text: So let it write, the right way: two real details, [1] cut what isn't true, and sign it yourself.
lines.show: So let it write, the right way: 2 real details, cut what isn't true, and sign it yourself.

lines.text: Ammamma replied to only one of them. [1] Guess which.
